'''June 2001 Fort Worth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fort Worth, Texas on 2 June 2001. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2407">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-fort-worth-tx-6-2-01d2407/ fort-worth-tx-6-2-01], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-fort-worth-tx-6-2-01d2407/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Fort Worth, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
